Responsibilities of the Candidate: Build and improve the orchestration layer that manages state transitions, context sharing, and intent routing across vendor and internal LLM frameworks in a distributed conversational environment. Develop production-grade Python services that bridge advanced AI and ML capabilities with reliable customer-facing products. Drive well-scoped ML projects from design through delivery, balancing technical trade-offs and collaborating across teams. Contribute to system design, coding standards, and AI/ML development best practices across the team. Partner with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to build secure, scalable, and high-performing AI-enabled experiences. Participate in design reviews and help ensure features meet Coinbase standards for security, compliance, and performance. Requirements: 2+ years of professional experience in machine learning and software engineering, with experience shipping production-grade ML services. Hands-on experience building with modern AI architectures such as LLMs and deep learning, and familiarity with tools such as LangGraph, LangSmith, Google ADK, Vertex AI, or AWS Bedrock. Strong proficiency in Python and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code. Working knowledge in at least one domain such as NLP, information retrieval, computer vision, or statistical modeling. Ability to write technical design documents and communicate ML system designs clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. Uses generative AI responsibly, applying human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

leads.title: Software Engineering Intern
leads.posting: About Heads Up For Tails Heads Up For Tails is India's most loved pet-care brand, with 100+ stores across 20 cities and a catalog of 5,000+ India-first, category-defining products, backed by an omni-channel network of manufacturing, retail, e-commerce and distribution. About The Role We are seeking an energetic, deeply curious Software Engineering Intern to join our fast-paced, high-growth engineering team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience building scalable applications while working alongside established industry leaders. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in modern web development who is eager to learn, build and take ownership of real-world features. Key Responsibilities Build & Contribute: Assist in designing and developing robust backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and MongoDB. Full-Stack Exposure: Support the team in delivering seamless user experiences across the MERN stack, bridging the gap between frontend components and backend data. Collaborate & Learn: Partner with senior engineers, product managers and designers to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Write Clean Code: Participate in code reviews, write unit tests and learn best practices for maintaining a scalable, production-grade codebase. Automate: Help build and maintain scripts or basic CI/CD workflows to streamline daily development and testing processes. Requirements Eligibility: Final-year student, recent graduate, or 0–1 year of experience. Core Foundation: Academic, bootcamp or project-based experience focused on the MERN stack. Backend Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of Node.js and MongoDB, including basic schema design and routing. The Right Mindset: You bring high energy and relentless curiosity. leads.title: AI Application Engineer + Product Engineer
leads.posting: Typify.dev ( https://typify.dev ) | AI Application Engineer + Product Engineer | San Francisco (hybrid / remote available) | VISA | $80-120K USD (Negotiable) | galen@typify.dev We're Typify, an education company for engineers that teaches functional programming and system design before pairing them with projects & job prospects. We're hiring for two roles: Both mid-senior, Angular + NestJS + Postgres. AI Application Engineer. Forward-deployed, ship LLM features close to real users, iterate on real usage, design guardrails and evals. RAG, agents, prompt and context engineering, tool orchestration. Bonus: conversational/voice AI, fine-tuning, healthcare AI, MCP. Product Engineer. Own features end to end, scope, build, ship, measure, iterate. Strong product sense, UX obsession for a sensitive health product. Bonus: consumer or health product experience, early-stage startup time. To apply: goto https://typify.dev/jobs/view/189 or https://typify.dev/jobs/view/188 . Just need your github and resume. More on how we think: github.com/TypifyDev, r/haskell (u/_lazyLambda), @SimpleHaskell on YouTube.
